title: Glitch PI Tools Manifest
description: Manifest of npm globals and standalone binaries the launcher expects. Read by scripts/ensure-tools.mjs (install on first run) and scripts/check-updates.mjs (compare installed vs latest, apply updates with backup + rollback).

name.description: Stable identifier used in filter, status file, and apply reports.

package.description: npm package name (required when type is npm).

binary.description: Binary name or repo-relative path to the executable.

version.description: Pinned version for binary downloads (unused for npm; current/latest detected at runtime).

platforms.description: Per-platform download config for binary entries.

url.description: Download URL. Supports ${version} (cleaned semver), ${tag} (raw release tag) and ${arch} (x64|arm64) templates resolved at apply time.

archive.description: Archive type for the extractor: zip, msi, or empty for raw binaries.

extract.description: File(s) to locate inside the extracted payload.

replaceDir.description: For zip payloads: repo-relative directory the extracted root replaces wholesale (e.g. data/node). Implies a directory swap with rollback.

restartRequired.description: When true, the launcher must restart after this entry is updated. The update subsystem backs up the package directory before install.

updateType.description: sync: subsystem compares installed vs latest and can auto-apply. manual: subsystem reports current version only and never applies. none: never checked.

latestUrl.description: Optional URL that resolves to the latest release. For github releases/latest URLs, the subsystem follows the redirect and parses the tag.

versionStrategy.description: How the installed state is judged: probe (default) runs the binary's --version; filedate compares the binary's mtime with the release published date (for binaries with no version flag, e.g. Handy).

restoreNpmGlobals.description: For replaceDir payloads that wipe data/node (the npm global prefix): snapshot every npm tool's installed version before the swap and reinstall them after.
